claim: Scaling a growth team no longer means headcount: the agents run the execution and draft the analysis, so a team of one runs the experiment program that used to take five, and every human hour goes on the calls only a human should make.
why_this_claim: It is the locked hook's own thesis, so the short opens on the line the longform was engineered to open on, and it closes on the longform's own payoff line (fewer people, higher velocity). The one body span is the C1 split, the mechanism that makes the hook's ratio true (execution to agents, analysis drafted by the agent, the human calls scrap or scale), which needs none of the other chapters (the fork, the one-on-ones, the four plays) to land. The seats (TEAM OF ONE / TEAM OF FIVE) are named by the hook's own labels, so no seat tag has to be explained.

spans.says: Scaling a growth team used to meet headcount. Now a team of one can run the same experiment program that used to take a team of five. And a team of five could run the same experiment program that used to take a team of 20. Welcome to the AI world.

outro.note: The shared take video-creation/assets/vo/cta-watch-full.mp3, never re-voiced. The card holds over the kicker's last frame (Mike with the JUDGMENT payoff word up in accent cyan), the house over-the-last-frame default; the bed is the project's one track happy-feet (MUSIC-PLAN.json), the final-chorus region under F8 is the natural pick since the kicker comes from it.

rejected.reason: F2, the fork (list the work you hate, pass it to a junior, zero leverage): the most quotable idea in the video, but 11.7 s on top of the 13 s hook overruns the 27 s budget by about 2.5 s even with no body, it is FACE on FACE (no visual variety against the hook), and its first word sits inside the F2 cut-in whip (23.4-23.77).

C2 what-the-agents-take list card: 'that list goes to the agents' has no referent cold (the list is defined by the previous line), and the bare six-item list from 50.20 has no verb; the card header does the work the audio cannot.

C1 STRATEGY column (Strategy stays human ... never the author): the cleaner opening of the split, but Strategy starts at 74.12 inside the F3 face-out whip (73.83-74.20), so it cannot be entered without clipping the word or cutting mid-whip; the EXECUTION/ANALYSIS half carries the claim on its own.
C3 experiment-loop diagram: the richest mechanism, but Agents starts at 164.06 inside the SPIN marquee (163.88-164.32) and the whole loop is 10.6 s, too long beside the hook.

Now, the one-on-ones ... an agent writes a status update before you even sit down: reads cold, good variety (C1 seats row, BR-7 b-roll with the calendar icon, the Statsig receipt panel), but it is the manager seat's tangent, not the experiment-program claim the hook makes, and its last word 'down' ends on the F5 cut-in whip (120.7). It is the designated FALLBACK body if the 90.48 boundary fails the lint (same 26.5 s total).
F7 Now, scale-up mode, where testing volume used to force headcount: a chapter opener that promises what follows, not a payoff; starts inside the F7 cut-in whip.
F4 That the agent is doing their thinking? That's not why you hired them: 'their' and 'them' point at the direct report defined 8 s earlier; fails the cold test.
And hey, click that subscribe button: adds 2.2 s (total 28.9 s, over the +1 s tolerance) and stacks a second CTA directly in front of the outro's CTA.
Programmatic SEO play: off the claim, and Agents at 201.56 sits at the BR-12 whip (201.6-201.97).

risks: Delivery and picture are inferred from the documents and the transcript, not watched or heard: I have not verified Mike's energy on any span or the vertical master's framing of the signature labels, the WELCOME pop, the word-by-word payoff or the C1 columns. The vertical lane's own QA (assets/vertical/VISUAL-QA.json) passes the C1 vertical renders; the label/pop placement beside the face in 9:16 is unverified.

Body out-point 90.48: the Whisper gap between scale. (90.46) and Here's (90.48) is 0.02 s. The lint will snap to the real trough; if that trough sits more than 1 frame late it lands inside the K3 cross-fade (90.5-90.85, a 0.35 s fade so the first 2 frames are under 17 percent blend). If the lint FAILS this boundary, swap the body for the fallback span 111.90-120.74 (COVER: C1 seats row -> BR-7 one-on-one -> C6 Statsig panel; 8.84 s, total 26.47 s) rather than re-timing.

Hook out-point 13.0: the word gap is 0.12 s (12.98-13.10); a trough snap of more than 1 frame lands on the first frame of the F1 face-out whip (13.0-13.37). The whip's first frame has near-zero displacement, so one frame is invisible; two or more are not.

Kicker in-point 216.93 is the first frame of the F8 cut-in whip: the L2 plays card whips away over the span's first 0.37 s before the face is clean. Every face cut-in in this video carries that whip on the join, so no FACE span other than F1 can be entered otherwise. The short's own seam hit (about 0.3 s) will sit on top of it; if Mike finds the double move ugly, the only clean alternative is to drop the kicker to a COVER line, which costs the payoff.

Kicker out-point 221.56 catches the JUDGMENT keyword pop 0.3 s into its Zoom Bounce (popped ON make at 221.26). The outro card follows immediately, so the pop never settles on screen; acceptable to me, Mike may prefer to end the kicker at 223.70 after click that subscribe button (delivered 31.8 s, over the target by 1.8 s).
